description: Deterministic seeded shuffle and train/val/test split of JSONL rows. The same seed and input always give the same split. Returns { seed, ratios, counts: { train, val, test, skipped }, train, val, test } (each split as JSONL) Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

jsonl.description: JSONL: one JSON object per line, up to 60,000 characters and 5,000 lines. Blank lines are ignored.

train.description: Share of rows for train. train + val + test must equal 1.

name: dataset-split
title: Seeded dataset split
